sloka: निस्संशयम् कार्यम् अवेक्षितव्यम्क्रिया विशेषो अपि अनुवर्तितव्यः ।न तु प्रवृद्धस्य दुरासदस्यकुमार वीर्यस्य फलम् च चिन्त्यम् ॥४-३०-१९॥
transliteration: nissaṁśayam kāryam avekṣitavyamkriyā viśeṣo api anuvartitavyaḥ ।na tu pravṛddhasya durāsadasyakumāra vīryasya phalam ca cintyam ॥4-30-19॥

translations.english: Rama said to Lakshmana, an unassailable warrior with auspicious signs, that what he had spoken was natural, beneficial, wise and useful.It is in accordance with Sama Veda and the science of statecraft, well established in dharma and artha.
